source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS OLE_DB_Source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS OLE_DB_Source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS OLE_DB_Source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS OLE_DB_Destination_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ODW_Product_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS ODW_Product_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ODW_Product_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS ODW_Product_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ODW_Product_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS ODW_Product_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'FACTSRPT_Product_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS FACTSRPT_Product_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'FACTSRPT_Product_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS FACTSRPT_Product_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'FACTSRPT_Product_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt') AS FACTSRPT_Product_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Claims_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_sink_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ODW_Claim_Summary_Load' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01') AS Load_Product_Data_from_Src_to_Tgt01_sink_TableName;

SELECT DISTINCT E.PDPD_ID AS {Copy of PDPD_ID}, D.PLDS_DESC AS {Copy of PLDS_DESC}, S.SBSB_CK, M.GRGR_CK, '' AS PRODUCT_TYPE AS {Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE}  FROM DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG E INNER JOIN DW.FAC_CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC D WITH(NOLOCK) ON E.CSPI_ID = D.CSPI_ID INNER JOIN DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER M WITH(NOLOCK) ON M.GRGR_CK = E.GRGR_CK AND M.MEME_CK = E.MEME_CK INNER JOIN DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC S WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.GRGR_CK = M.GRGR_CK AND S.SBSB_CK = M.SBSB_CK WHERE E.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND E.SGSG_CK>0 AND (D.PLDS_DESC LIKE '%HARP%' OR E.[PDPD_ID] LIKE 'NY%' ) ORDER BY E.[PDPD_ID];

SELECT PRPR.MCTN_ID AS {Copy of MCTN_ID}, CLCL.PDPD_ID AS "PRODUCTID", CLCL.CLCL_ID AS "CLAIM", SUM(CDML.CDML_PR_PYMT_AMT) AS "SVCSPAID",CT.PRODUCT_TYPE  FROM DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM CLCL WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN DW.FAC_CMC_CDML_CL_LINE CDML WITH(NOLOCK) ON CDML.CLCL_ID=CLCL.CLCL_ID INNER JOIN DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR WITH(NOLOCK) ON CDML.PRPR_ID = PRPR.PRPR_ID WHERE CLCL.PDPD_ID LIKE 'NY%' AND CONVERT(DATE, CLCL.CLCL_PAID_DT) BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(YEAR, - ?, GETDATE())) AND CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()) AND CLCL.CLCL_CUR_STS='02' AND CDML.CDML_CUR_STS='02' AND CDML.CDML_PR_PYMT_AMT>0 GROUP BY PRPR.MCTN_ID,CLCL.PDPD_ID, CLCL.CLCL_ID;
